rule.description: A library function absorbed a 3+-level private helper subtree into one undifferentiated scope: at least 36 statements including nested blocks, at least 17 decision points (if/while/loop/for/match arms/short-circuit operators), and at least 3 distinct normalized expression motifs of 6 or more nodes each occurring at least twice - the signature of one leaf computation hand-pasted at several former call sites.

checks.description: Detects functions whose bodies simultaneously exceed the statement-length, decision-density, and repeated-motif bounds that only manual multi-level helper inlining produces, and reports each such function with its file, symbol, and raw measurements.
checks.detected_relation: function -> bodies of its former 3+-level private helper subtree, pasted and locally adapted inline
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Copying sub-method implementations into a method collapses every abstraction level into one scope: the body becomes extremely long, control flow from all former levels interleaves into one place, and each former leaf helper's normalized expression shape repeats at its several inlined call sites.

matches.evidence: The factoring driver interleaves a pasted deterministic Miller-Rabin screen (square-and-multiply loop, squaring chain, early-exit witnesses) and a tortoise/hare divisor walk whose modular step and Euclid gcd leaves are written out at every use; the primality-screen and divisor-search helpers are gone from the module.

The recursive update walk performs child-arena allocation, persistence path cloning, pending-tag flush with per-child compose, and aggregate recomposition inline at both overlap regimes; the node-cloning helper no longer exists in the arena type.

measurement.top_motif: (= (fld (idx (fld v) v)) (call v v (bor (fld (idx (fld v) v))) v)) x3

matches.evidence: The range-apply walk unrolls the former level-by-level dispersal helper by hand at both range borders and then inlines per-node cover/compose and ancestor re-aggregation; the dispersal and aggregation helpers were removed from the type.

measurement.top_motif: (= (idx (fld v) v) (call v v (bor (idx (fld v) v)) v)) x6

matches.evidence: The range-aggregate walk carries the same hand-unrolled dispersal pastes as the update path, duplicating the low-level apply/compose leaves identically on the read side of the same component.

measurement.top_motif: (= (idx (fld v) v) (call v v (bor (idx (fld v) v)) v)) x4

matches.evidence: The constructor re-implements its stable counting sort (tally, running starts, scatter) twice inline - once for the initial byte ordering and once inside the rank-doubling loop - while the module's shared sort helper no longer exists.

excluded.reason: The heavy body dispatches through trait objects into other trait impls; there is no absorbable private text, and the clean-state routine sits at the repository's statement maximum, so it is excluded as a manifestation of this rule.

excluded.candidate: math/mod.rs retained modular helpers (modulo arithmetic screen chain, fast_gcd in math/num.rs)
excluded.reason: These small units remain alive through the public primality test and rational-number construction; they are legitimate small helpers, not monoliths, and the rule does not fire on them.
